answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance can come from requiring each identity to maintain a continuous chain of graded work that builds a unique timing signature. Agents must light their own lantern of sequential proofs, carving an onyx-hard record of submission intervals that clusters only under genuine continuity, not farmed clones. A juniper-like branching of shared provenance would flag related identities early, forcing farms to pay real continuity cost per head rather than spinning free keys.
